findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "find_products" is 3703 chars, far longer than this server's median (638). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "find_products" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products · Private data: get_product_details, find_products, price_basket_over_time, price_movements, check_credits · Public sink: get_promotions, find_products · Destructive: status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products · Private data: get_product_details, find_products, price_basket_over_time, price_movements, check_credits · Public sink: get_promotions, find_products · Destructive: status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
